steps: During the first week of next semester, get the latest completion form online, from your dean's office, or from the Registrar's Office.
Fill out the form and prepare your missing requirement.
Look for Sir Kito. Sending a private message the day before makes this go more smoothly.
I will check and score your missing requirement, compute your new final grade, write it on your completion form, and sign it.
Submit the completion form to your dean's office for signing. They will either ask you to bring the form, signed by me and your dean, to the Registrar's Office, or submit it there themselves.
Wait for your INC to change to your new final grade.
completion.receiving: Whenever you leave a signed form with any office, keep a photocopy and have the receiving office sign it as received. This is your proof if the office loses your document.
